# Evidence capture

Copy `evidence/templates/AI-ACTIVITY-TEMPLATE.md`. Record activity ID, timestamp/time zone, reviewer, objective, tool/agent, prompt/skill, context, output summary, changed files, findings, assumptions, exact commands and observed results, decision, amendments/rejections, questions, residual risk, and lesson. Mark commands not run as not run. Exclude secrets, customer data, and unnecessary personal data. Validate identifiers and links.
